description: Read a Microsoft Advertising ad account’s account-level settings (Microsoft’s GetAccountProperties): TrackingUrlTemplate, FinalUrlSuffix, MSCLKIDAutoTaggingEnabled, AdClickParallelTracking, IncludeViewThroughConversions, ProfileExpansionEnabled, AllowImageAutoRetrieve, BusinessAttributes, AssetAIEnhancementOptout, AIDetectedContentWatermarkPolicy and the rest Microsoft returns, each flagged settable or read-only here. A property Microsoft does not return is reported as UNREAD (often a feature that has not reached the account yet), never as off or empty. AIDetectedContentWatermarkPolicy is the account-level AI-detected content watermark policy; Microsoft has not documented its values, so report what the account stores verbatim and do not guess what it means. Read-only, 0 credits.

adAccountId.description: Microsoft ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

names.description: narrow to some account property names, e.g. ["AIDetectedContentWatermarkPolicy"]; all of them by default

name: get_microsoft_ads_account_properties
title: Read Microsoft Advertising account settings
